tools.name: emt_catalog
tools.description: Current GPU offers. Prices in EUR micro-units per GPU/hour; unknown metrics remain null. Paginated to keep responses small.

tools.name: emt_clusters
tools.description: Current whole-node cluster offers; fabric declarations do not establish independent EMT qualification.

tools.name: emt_templates
tools.description: Public GPU container templates for ordinary rentals.

tools.name: emt_experiment_presets
tools.description: List scientific presets or inspect one preset's parameters, equations, methods and custom-input schema. Does not run a calculation.

tools.name: emt_orders
tools.description: Owned GPU orders and lifecycle states. Requires read scope.

tools.name: emt_experiment_jobs
tools.description: Owned experiment jobs, including reports and release state. Requires read scope.

tools.name: emt_experiment_job
tools.description: Inspect an owned experiment and its authenticated result, output and calculation-report download links. Files are not sent into the model context.

tools.name: emt_training_jobs
tools.description: List owned AI training jobs. Requires read scope; does not start training or rent GPUs.

tools.name: emt_training_job
tools.description: Inspect an owned training job, its settings, lifecycle and recorded outcome.

tools.name: emt_training_recipe
tools.description: Read the reproducible recipe for an owned training job, including model, dataset and training settings.

tools.name: emt_training_events
tools.description: Read up to 100 training events with metrics, runtime and observed dataset hashes when recorded. For full history start after=0 and latest=false, then repeat with the greatest returned seq until an empty page. latest=true returns the most recent window only. Visible devices are not proof of GPU utili

tools.name: emt_monitor
tools.description: Metrics and lifecycle for an owned order. Missing telemetry is unknown.

tools.name: emt_quote
tools.description: Create a fresh expiring GPU quote without renting or charging.

tools.name: emt_cluster_quote
tools.description: Quote selected whole nodes on one fabric without renting.

tools.name: emt_experiment_quote
tools.description: Quote 1–4 nodes for an experiment; hours × hourly gives the GPU rental ceiling in micro-EUR. Reserve is only an initial hold, not total cost.

tools.name: emt_rent
tools.description: Start a PAID GPU rental. Requires explicit spending authorization, fresh quote, rent scope, credit and accepted terms. Store payload and key before requesting.

tools.name: emt_rent_cluster
tools.description: Start a PAID whole-node cluster rental. Public SSH key only. Confirm cost and fabric limits with the user first.

tools.name: emt_start_experiment
tools.description: Start a PAID scientific preset, customer script or command. Parameter sets distribute across quoted nodes; this does not automatically parallelize a single solver. Auto-continuation may rent additional segments up to its budget. Review all costs before confirming.

tools.name: emt_attach_cluster_experiment
tools.description: Attach work to an already rented dedicated 2–4-node cluster. Does NOT start SSH remotely: run emt_cluster.py locally with the returned job ID and your private key. Whole cluster stops on completion/cancel; billing continues during preparation.

tools.name: emt_cancel_experiment
tools.description: Cancel an owned experiment and request release of all its GPU nodes or attached cluster. Unfinished work can be lost. Recheck releasing until false.

tools.name: emt_terminate
tools.description: Terminate every node in an owned rental. Local disks are deleted; retained volumes and backups remain billed. Inspect status until release is confirmed.
